reviews.sourceContext: Within selected-branch-follow after SAR, before stramenopiles-summary
reviews.scientificInterpretation: Stramenopiles belong within SAR; this diagram is an educational path focusing on a subset, not a verified immediate ancestor-descendant edge.
reviews.caveat: The SAR clade also contains alveolates and rhizarians; placement/order among these clades should not be asserted by a visual vertical connector.

reviews.sourceContext: Within selected-branch-follow after stramenopiles-summary, before brown-summary
reviews.scientificInterpretation: Brown algae (Phaeophyceae) are a subgroup within photosynthetic stramenopiles (Ochrophyta); not all stramenopiles are brown algae, and the visual step omits intervening groups.
reviews.caveat: Do not assert direct lineage derivation from a generic stramenopile summary node, or describe all stramenopiles as photosynthetic.
